BiblicalUsage: To live out the rest of one's life is the word for spending existence — and it appears once, in Peter's call to a changed life. In 1 Peter 4:2 he says the believer should no longer live the rest of his time in the flesh to the lusts of men, but to the will of God. A short word for a whole remaining life.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Peter's one use says it all: the time left is to be lived to God's will, not to men's lusts.
